entries.073c44662efccd04: Plans, develops, operates and distributes smartphone games. Main products include "Puzzle & Dragons", "Ragnarok X: Next Generation" (Japanese name: "Ragnarok X"), "Ragnarok M: Eternal Love" (Japanese name: "Ragnarok Masters") and "Summoners Board". Users purchase items usable within games and pay usage fees through payments made via platform companies.
entries.2186dabb5f70c049: This business, carried out by the company group comprising the company and 18 consolidated subsidiaries (19 companies in total), provides mainly online games delivered via the internet. It is a single segment, and the entire consolidated revenue of ¥93,242 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025 comes from this business. The business centers on smartphone games, and its main product is "Puzzle & Dragons". Overseas, it delivers games directly through group companies and also expands through licensing to local distribution companies.

entries.a6430b27de6ad3c6: The company has a single segment, and the entire consolidated revenue of ¥93,242 million comes from the Online Game Business. Revenue by region was ¥31,831 million in Japan, ¥14,370 million in Taiwan, ¥17,531 million in Asia, ¥9,011 million in North America and ¥8,982 million in Indonesia, among others, and total overseas revenue exceeds that of Japan. The information on major customers, as printed in the filing, shows sales of ¥34,978 million to Apple Inc., a platform provider, ¥16,378 million to Google LLC, and ¥10,784 million to Razer Inc., a payment agent; all of these relate to usage fees and similar charges paid by users of the game services.
entries.b459a4d9c694480a: Its foundation is operating know-how from titles it has run over long periods, including Ragnarok Online, which marked its 23rd anniversary since launch, and Puzzle & Dragons, which marked its 14th anniversary in February 2026. Through the Gravity group of South Korea, it has a structure for rolling out Ragnarok-related titles around the world, and it continues global rollouts of new titles, including starting distribution of 'Ragnarok: Twilight' in Southeast Asia in October 2025.
